name: IndiGo

snapshot.about: India's largest passenger airline operating domestic and international flights.

narrative: Management projected capacity addition of around 3 to 4 percent for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, and actual reported capacity growth met this expectation at 3 percent. Meanwhile, total income grew strongly by nearly 20 percent year over year.

cash.read: Operating cash flow over FY22 to FY26 was ₹83,658 crore, which entirely covered the reported profit of ₹6,568 crore during the same period.

bull.point: Dominant market position and solid liquidity buffers recognized by rating agencies alongside robust free cash holdings.

evidence.quote: CRISIL and ICRA highlighted the Company’s dominant domestic market leadership (approximately 64% market share), cost competitiveness, and strong liquidity position as key credit strengths
ended the December quarter with free cash of 369.4 billion rupees and a restricted cash of 146.6 billion rupees

bull.point: Strong international and domestic traffic demand supported healthy total income growth across quarters.

evidence.quote: This resulted in a flattish domestic capacity growth and a growth of more than 26 percent on international sectors, as compared to the same period last year
reported a total income of 256 billion rupees, a growth of around 19% year over year

bull.point: Management successfully delivered on capacity growth guidance matching the projected 3 percent rate.

evidence.quote: we are expecting to add capacity of around 3-4 percent in Q1FY27 as compared to the same period last year
June quarter’s capacity growth came in at 3% on a year-over-year basis, broadly in line with our guidance

bear.point: Significant exposure to taxation disputes, legal claims, and ongoing appeals regarding aircraft manufacturer incentives.

evidence.quote: The income tax authority has assessed the return of income of the Company up to Assessment Year (“AY”) 2022-23 and has revised the taxable income for certain years on account of disallowance of certain expenses and in respect of the tax treatment of certain incentives received from the manufacturer in respect of acquisition of aircraft and engines
Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹83,658 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹6,568 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Substantial commitments toward lease liabilities and aircraft redelivery obligations create long-term financial pressure.

evidence.quote: The Company considers lease liabilities as part of debt for internal leverage monitoring because aircraft leases represent a significant long-term financing commitment and are integral to fleet capacity planning and funding decisions
total debt, including the capitalized operating lease liability of around 768.6 billion rupees

bear.point: Vulnerability to external volatility including geopolitical tensions, foreign exchange fluctuations, and high aviation turbine fuel prices.

evidence.quote: Additionally, outlook revisions later in FY 2026 were owing to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East leading to airspace disruptions, elevated ATF prices and currency volatility
Including the impact of foreign exchange movement, we reported a loss of around 25.8 billion rupees during the quarter
